title: Download and unzip the starter folder
caption: One zip with everything the workshop needs. Unzip it into a real folder: on Windows, right-click it and choose Extract All.

unzip.windowsWarning: Right-click, not double-click. On Windows a double-click only looks inside the zip; it does not unzip it.

one-link-one-zip.title: One link, one zip
one-link-one-zip.script: There is one link to one zip file. Download it, and then unzip it. On a Mac, double-click the zip. On Windows, right-click it and choose Extract All. On Linux, use Extract here in your file manager. Inside you will find the files the workshop needs, already in place, so there is nothing to assemble.

where-it-lives.title: Where it lives
where-it-lives.script: Take a second to notice where the folder landed, usually in your Downloads. The next step goes into exactly this folder, so if you remember where it is, the rest is easy.
